issuer: Civil Enforcement Directorate, Court Notice Division, Shimla
summary: This is a show cause summons warning that your commercial trade license will be canceled unless you pay a fee of Rs. 6,000 and provide an explanation.

actions.task: Pay statutory fee of Rs. 6,000 and file written explanation or appear for hearing
actions.why_it_matters: Prevent revocation of trade license, property sealing orders, and police enforcement

documents_needed: Copy of valid trade license certificate
Audited turnover statement for previous financial year
Identity proof of authorized signatory (Aadhaar or Passport)
if_ignored: Commercial establishment license will be revoked, sealing orders issued, and police enforcement requested.
